tools.name: convert_document_to_markdown
tools.description: pdfpeek: Price: USD 0.005; No free tier for full conversion. For PDF tables as rows use extract_pdf_tables. Use when an agent must read a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, HTML or EPUB file as Markdown text. Returns Markdown and size (pages, chars, tokens_estimate: chars/4, not a tokenizer count). Forma

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "convert_document_to_markdown" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "convert_document_to_markdown" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
